description: This file provides functions for managing video meetings, including creating, updating, deleting meetings, and retrieving recordings and transcripts from a Cal Video provider, with fallback to cal.com video. It interacts with external services and APIs related to video conferencing.

methods.name: getBusyVideoTimes
methods.description: Fetches availability times from all video adapters for given credentials.

methods.name: createMeeting
methods.description: Creates a video meeting using the specified credentials and calendar event, with fallback to cal.com video if creation fails.

methods.name: updateMeeting
methods.description: Updates an existing video meeting with new calendar event details.

methods.name: deleteMeeting
methods.description: Deletes a video meeting by UID.

methods.name: createMeetingWithCalVideo
methods.description: Creates a cal.com video meeting as a fallback.

methods.name: createInstantMeetingWithCalVideo
methods.description: Creates an instant cal.com video room.

methods.name: getRecordingsOfCalVideoByRoomName
methods.description: Retrieves recordings for a specified cal video room.

methods.name: getDownloadLinkOfCalVideoByRecordingId
methods.description: Gets download link for a recording by ID.

methods.name: getAllTranscriptsAccessLinkFromRoomName
methods.description: Retrieves transcript access links for a room.

methods.name: getAllTranscriptsAccessLinkFromMeetingId
methods.description: Retrieves transcript access links for a meeting.

methods.name: submitBatchProcessorTranscriptionJob
methods.description: Submits a transcription job for a recording.

methods.name: getTranscriptsAccessLinkFromRecordingId
methods.description: Gets transcript access link for a recording.

methods.name: checkIfRoomNameMatchesInRecording
methods.description: Checks if a room name matches in a recording.

methods.name: getCalVideoMeetingSessionsByRoomName
methods.description: Retrieves meeting sessions for a room.
